subject: Personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 sampling - staff verification packet & revocations
messages:
From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@secureaudit.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 sampling - personnel lifecycle evidence request

Hi Michael,

As part of the SOC 2 readiness review for Redwood Inference, SecureAudit is sampling personnel controls for onboarding and offboarding. Please provide the following artifacts for our sample window (Jan 1, 2027 - Jun 30, 2028):

- CSV manifest of active headcount + hire dates (machine-readable)
- Training completion exports for security awareness and data handling (exports from LMS including timestamps)
- Redacted copies of background-check results for sampled users (PII removed per your guidance)
- Access revocation logs for terminated users (showing timestamp and who performed revocation)

We'd like the materials uploaded to a shared Drive folder and a short attestation from your security or HR lead confirming redaction approach and sample selection method. Target turnaround: 7 business days (by 2028-07-11).

Let me know if you need a narrower scope or if ClearHire should pull redacted PDFs directly (I've cc'd them for convenience).

Thanks,
Alice Martin
Senior Auditor, SecureAudit Inc
alice.martin@secureaudit.com

Attachments: none
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 sampling - personnel lifecycle evidence request

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a packet and share a Drive folder.

Ben (HR) / Stephanie (Security) / Monica (Ops) — can you confirm availability to pull these exports and redact as requested? I suggest we:

1) Produce the CSV manifest and training export (Ben + Monica)
2) Coordinate redaction with ClearHire for the sampled background reports (Ben + ClearHire)
3) Produce access revocation log and short attestation from Security (Stephanie)

I'll plan a delivery update by EOD Thu (2028-07-05). If we anticipate delay, we'll push the target but notify SecureAudit now.

-Michael
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
